title: CryptoPotatoes
tagline: Memory game where users can match cute pairs of potatoes and buy as NFTs
description: We have created a very simple memory game where users can find and match cute and adorable designs of potatoes (as it's a trend that people refer to themselves as potato lately). The aim is to create a relaxing and straightforward experience whilst utilizing ethereum on the game.
how_its_made:
We referred to a youtube video tutorial on how to build the game from scratch. The game utilizes ethereum, solidity and Javascript.



As we joined the HackFS with zero knowledge in Solidity, Ethereum, IPFS and the world of decentralized web in general, we used a Youtube tutorial video as our reference. We then tweaked the game using React JS to add a countdown timer for some added challenge for our players. To enhance the user experience, we changed the design of the site using CSS Bootstrap to make it straightforward and easy on the eyes of the players.
